newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokuyama down sharply on lower profit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Tokuyama down sharply on lower profit forecast.

text.p: Shares of Tokuyama Corp fell sharply on the Tokyo Stock Exchange on Thursday morning due to the company's announcement on Wednesday that it had cut its group profit forecast for the year to March 31, 1997.
By 0035, Tokuyama was down 24 yen, or 3.83 percent, at 603 yen.
The chemical maker was the sixth-largest percentage loser so far on the first section of the TSE.
Tokuyama on Wednesday cut its forecast for group net profit for 1996/97 to 2.0 billion yen from its previous forecast of 3.50 billion yen.
Its actual 1995/96 group net profit was 3.64 billion yen.
